# Test fixtures

Everything here is **synthetic** (written for this project) unless a row says otherwise. Never
add real meeting audio, transcripts, vault content or personal data. Audio fixtures follow
SPECIFICATION §15.5 Q4: clips of at most 60 s and 2 MB named `*.fixture.<ext>`, with source,
licence and speaker consent recorded below.

## `notes/` (Phase 03)
| File | Source | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `2026-10-11 - Product Sync.md` | Synthetic; generated by `tests/unit/test_golden.py` | Golden note: frontmatter, Appendix B header, four sections, AI Recommendations last |
| `2026-10-11 - Product Sync.transcript.md` | Synthetic; generated by `tests/unit/test_golden.py` | Golden companion transcript paired with the note (merged turns, an unmapped speaker, data block) |
| `user-edited.md` | Synthetic, hand-written | A note edited the way a user would in Obsidian: block-style lists, a frontmatter comment, a user property, a callout, text between sections, an edited heading, trailing text |
| `damaged-markers.md` | Synthetic, hand-written | A section whose closing marker was deleted (R11 error path) next to an intact section |

The names and people are invented. Regenerate the golden pair with
`MM3_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 uv run pytest tests/unit/test_golden.py` and review the diff; the format
itself is defined in `docs/dev-guide/note-format.md`.

## `assembler/` (Phase 09)
| File | Source | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `<template-id>.txt` | Synthetic; generated by `tests/unit/templates/test_assembler.py` | Golden prompts per built-in template (system message, each section's tail, the shared context) for a fixed invented meeting |

Regenerate with `MM3_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 uv run pytest tests/unit/templates/test_assembler.py` after an
intended prompt change and review the diff.

## `tests/eval/meetings/` (Phase 09)
Three synthetic meetings written for the generation eval (`launch-sync`, `cache-design-review`,
`budget-checkin`): invented people and companies, with the expected decisions, actions (and owners)
and open questions. CC0. See `tests/eval/run_eval.py`.

## `audio/` (Phase 06)
| File | Source | Licence | Speakers and consent | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ami-es2002a-two-speakers.fixture.opus` | [AMI Meeting Corpus](https://groups.inf.ed.ac.uk/ami/corpus/) meeting ES2002a, `ES2002a.Mix-Headset.wav`, seconds 500-560 (`ffmpeg -ss 500 -t 60 ... -ac 1 -ar 16000 -c:a libopus -b:a 32k -map_metadata -1`); 60 s, 187 KB, SHA-256 `046f19ac30685b2fe9df9613aa4a66167d7d6fb52ae612920720929e7d5b44c2` | CC-BY-4.0 (attribution: AMI Meeting Corpus, University of Edinburgh and the AMI Consortium) | Two participants (AMI speakers B and D, about 32 s of speech each per the AMI manual segment annotations; no other speaker in the window). Recorded by the AMI project with participant consent for publication under the corpus licence. | GPU acceptance test (`tests/integration/test_transcription_gpu.py`): at least 2 speakers, words "price" and "retail" |

Long and private recordings are never committed. The `slow` GPU test reads them from
`MM3_PRIVATE_TEST_AUDIO` (a file or a folder) and prints only numbers (duration, speed, speaker
count), never names or transcript text.
